known_parity_gaps: A duplicate SessionEvent calls to_canonical_dict and Rust returns NORMALIZE_CANONICAL_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits an SL003 finding.
A duplicate mapping returns CANONICAL_JSON_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE. Python emits a finding. Do not build the provenance dict and do not hash.
Overflow cap_findings calls make_finding with the fingerprint omitted. Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE. Python appends an overflow finding.
diff_field_names of two events returns NORMALIZE_CANONICAL_UNAVAILABLE. Python returns field names. Do not invent names.
A float id is PYTHON_FLOAT_STR_UNREPRESENTABLE. Rust Display is not Python str.
A list or mapping id is PYTHON_STR_UNREPRESENTABLE. No Python repr.
A bool is not an int. True becomes the text True only as an id coercion.
EvidenceLookup::Borrowed is a failed borrow, not a missing key.
